verdict.rationale: Kushki's docs include pages for creating recurring charges and managing scheduled charges, plus a page on external subscriptions. That shows a first-party recurring-billing capability, but the evidence is only page titles with no detail. missing for 10: subscription plans/plan catalog, free trials, upgrades/downgrades, proration, and any detailed documentation or hands-on corroboration of the recurring-charge flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration
